== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Daruman was a legendary ruler who unified his [[Iteration]], ushering in an era of prosperity characterized by high levels of education, happiness, and integrity. His pursuit of absolute truth became a cultural standard. Originally selected by the second [[Court]] of Seven to serve as an [[Executor]], he acted as an agent for the [[Abidan]]. Because he was not bound by the [[Eledari Pact]], he possessed the unique ability to interfere with [[Fate]] and manipulate destiny to his own will. Following a mission for the [[Judges]], Daruman turned against the [[Abidan]], declaring them tyrants and vowing to destroy them. He relocated his people to a new world, transforming his original [[Iteration]] into the massive [[fortress]] known as [[Tal’gullour]]. Within this stronghold, he is referred to as The [[Mad King|the Mad King]]. Daruman's power is immense; even as a mortal, he could challenge world-eating entities. He possesses the ability to harness the powers of a [[Class One Fiends|Class One Fiend]], specifically [[Oth’kimeth]], which resides within him. While the [[Fiend]] is a demonic presence with bone-like features and crimson eyes, Daruman has demonstrated the capacity to maintain self-control and use such chaotic power for good. In combat, Daruman is a formidable warrior capable of engaging [[Judges]]. He has wielded both his own [[sword]] and the [[Reaper’s Scythe|Reaper's Scythe]], using these weapons to strike at the [[Abidan]]. His history includes a significant battle with Ozriel, a conflict that left his status and the state of his [[Iteration]] a subject of mystery. Throughout his existence, Daruman has sought to dismantle the existing system to build something new, often wrestling with the complexities of [[Fate]] and the Void.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Daruman is a combatant engaged in a battle against Ozriel, an opponent whose actions were meant to limit Daruman's options. During their conflict, Daruman successfully destroyed Ozriel's Mantle and is expected to emerge from [[Vesper]] as the victor.}}

=== {{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|The Sector Lockdown}} ===
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Daruman initiated a lockdown on the [[Sector]] and was anticipated to emerge from [[Vesper]] as the victor of his conflict with Ozriel.<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c6">''Waybound'', chapter 6</ref> As a combatant, he successfully destroyed Ozriel's Mantle and managed to weather The [[Mad King|the Mad King]]'s attack by utilizing gold circles anchored by a [[fortress]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c22">''Waybound'', chapter 22</ref> It is possible that Daruman arrived at [[Cradle]].<ref name="cradle-12-waybound-c35">''Waybound'', chapter 35</ref>}}
